title: Guest Mode Reload Survives
h1: Shop Pay guest mode on lucasmrichtest, reload after landing in Pay checkout
subtitle: Frames from the Playwright trace of spec 3, run from Erin's machine against production on 2026-09-29. Spec 2 plus a full page reload once the buyer is in Pay checkout. Each frame is an unedited screencast still.

moments.name: checkout-landing
moments.title: Checkout opens
moments.body: Cart permalink on lucasmrichtest.myshopify.com, one Snake Plant Laurentii at CAD 59.

moments.name: shop-pay-clicked
moments.title: Shop Pay button clicked
moments.body: The express-checkout Shop Pay button opens the Accounts sign-in iframe.

moments.name: email-submitted
moments.title: Email submitted
moments.body: Benchmark alias {email}, then Continue. The treatment decision is made here.

moments.name: pay-checkout-landed
moments.title: Guest mode: straight into Pay checkout
moments.body: No phone entry, no SMS code. Buyer email in the header, empty Canada shipping form.

moments.name: reload-in-flight
moments.title: Page reload
moments.body: page.reload() discards all client state. The only thing the server has to identify the buyer is the session cookie.

moments.name: after-reload
moments.title: Still Pay checkout after reload, same email
moments.body: The spec asserts the URL still ends in /shoppay on the same host, checkout re-hydrates, and the header shows {email}.

moments.name: form-filled
moments.title: Address, phone and card filled on the reloaded session
moments.body: Default Canadian address, benchmark phone, test card.

moments.name: order-confirmed
moments.title: Order confirmed
moments.body: Thank-you page, confirmation {order}. The reloaded guest session could still pay.

proves: The guest session is cookie-backed: a fresh server render of /shoppay recognises the unverified, phoneless buyer without re-authentication.
A reload from the same browser is not treated as a competing session; address save and Pay now still succeed afterwards.
Same store, variant and override as run 2, so the only new variable is the reload.
caveats: Reload only. Closing the tab and reopening /shoppay, or opening it in a second tab, is not exercised.
Moment timestamps for the reload frames are estimates; check the shots folder if a caption does not match its still.
Store is on pod 233; the e2e framework warns E2E shops must be on pod 21, so this spec stays local.
Benchmark identity: fixed email code and simulated SMS; one run, one browser.
